page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Enhanced server family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor clocked at 3.3 GHz across an x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs derived from 8 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 33 MB L3 cache. Hardware vector acceleration is enabled via AVX-512 with VNNI and bfloat16 support. The system features 64.0 GB of memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. It contains no bundled local storage and includes zero discrete graphics processing units.

In networking, the instance delivers a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. Benchmark results place the server solidly in the middle 50 percent tier across CPU and memory assessments. The stress-ng multi-core CPU benchmark reached 16609.17, while PassMark CPU registered 18072.94. Memory throughput for uncached large blocks achieved 97.46 GB/sec in read operations and 51.81 GB/sec in write operations. Operational throughput tests demonstrated 15.95 million Redis SET operations per second and static web serving throughput of 13.75 GB/sec. An architectural tradeoff is the absence of local disk drives, necessitating network-attached volumes for non-volatile storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the balanced ratio prevents overprovisioning compute or memory for general workloads. The combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores, vector execution capabilities, and 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth makes ecs.g7ne.4xlarge suited for middle-tier application servers, containerized microservices, relational databases running on remote storage, and batch data processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance in the Enhanced family featuring 16 dedicated vCPUs from 8 physical cores and 64.0 GB of RAM. Driven by a 3.3 GHz Intel Xeon 8369HB processor equipped with a 33 MB L3 cache, the system includes AVX-512 instruction extensions with VNNI and bfloat16 support. There are zero discrete GPUs and no bundled local storage volumes, requiring external network storage for persistent disk operations. Benchmark evaluations place the instance consistently within the median tier, evidenced by a multi-core stress-ng rating of 16609.17 and 15.95 million Redis SET operations per second alongside 12 Gbps baseline networking. These performance characteristics and balanced resource distribution render the server efficient for web application hosting, relational databases using remote storage volumes, enterprise microservices, and continuous integration pipelines.
